title: Windows Software -> macOS Alternatives Manifest
description: A comprehensive manifest of conventional Windows software and its macOS counterparts, ordered by matching capability. Where the SAME application ships an official macOS build (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Cloud, WhatsApp, Logic Pro, ...) that native build is the first alternative, ahead of any substitute. Includes every column from B_installed_windows_software.csv plus additional common Windows software scraped from the web.

Same engine and on-disk format as Windows; migrate databases by restoring your .bak backups (RESTORE DATABASE). x86_64 only; officially packaged for Ubuntu (apt), RHEL (dnf) and SLES (zypper) - not for Arch. If on Windows it ran inside a Docker CONTAINER instead of on the host, it is migrated as a container by the Docker rebuild step, not by this native install.

After the package installs, finish setup as root:  sudo ACCEPT_EULA=Y MSSQL_PID=Developer MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD='YourStrong!Passw0rd' /opt/mssql/bin/mssql-conf -n setup  then  sudo systemctl enable --now mssql-server . Restore your databases from their .bak backups. A containerised SQL Server on Windows is migrated by the Docker rebuild step instead.  macOS counterpart of (Microsoft SQL Server (macOS)): SQL Server (Docker on macOS).  The SQL Server image is amd64-only: on Apple Silicon enable Rosetta emulation in Docker Desktop, or use the mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge image, which is native arm64.
